**cli:** `action-log`, `ai-cli-readify`, `commit`, `commit-and-push`, `commit-history`, `diff`, `dig-history`, `fetch`, `file-history`, `list-branches`, `list-errors`, `new-branch`, `push`, `recall`, `repo-state`, `review-changes`, `search-history`, `sync-branch`, `ultraflow` and `web-search` left the binary and ship as plugins. Without the plugin each prints its `pixel install github:Pixel-CLI/<repo>` command and exits 2; the old names stay accepted as aliases until 1.0.
